test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

His wife is **__aiding and abets__** him in his dishonest deeds.
solution:
The correct answer is **"aiding and abetting​.****"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence** "His wife is aiding and abets him in his dishonest deeds."** contains a grammatical error.
 
• The correct form uses **"aiding and abetting" **as a compound verb to convey the idea of assisting and supporting someone in their dishonest actions.
 
• The correct verb form after **"aiding and"** is **"abetting,"** not **"abets."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 ​

Correct sentence: *His wife is **aiding and abetting**__ him in his dishonest deeds.*
